newsitem.title: USA: Spelling Entertainment hires Clark as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Spelling Entertainment hires Clark as CFO.

text.p: Spelling Entertainment Group said it hired William Clark as chief financial officer to replace Tom Carson, who resigned in September.
Clark's hiring is effective immediately. Clark, 42, has been an executive at Walt Disney Co since 1989, where he was most recently senior vice president of finance.
At Spelling, Clark will oversee the financial and planning functions of Spelling Entertainment group and its units, the company said.
In addition to chief financial officer, Clark will assume the title of senior vice president at Spelling, the company added.
